name.value: Brewers Corner - The Nanaimo Wine Shoppe

description.value: Brewers Corner is a homebrew supply shop and U-Brew facility where customers bring in kits or fresh fruit and use the owner-operated, climate-controlled equipment to ferment and bottle their own wine, beer, or cider on premise. Founded in 2019 by Wendy and Guillermo, who together bring decades of brewing expertise, the shop also stocks specialty ingredients including nitrogen-flushed pellet hops, Gambrinus barley, and specialty coffee beans. A touring cyclist with a taste for DIY craft beverages or in search of quality coffee supplies will find knowledgeable, owner-run service at this community-focused Nanaimo shop.
